plan.notes: Official 8-semester plan, Messiah University Department of Computing, Mathematics and Physics (cmp-8-semester-plans-2025-26.pdf), for students matriculating beginning Fall 2024. Term sequence, semester placement, and credits transcribed from the official plan; where the plan gives a Min/Max credit range the Min value is recorded, and each semester's Min-sum was verified against the plan's official semester Total row. Course titles from the official Messiah University undergraduate catalog (SmartCatalog 2025-2026). 'Professional Semester' is a section label in the source, not a course. Prerequisites not transcribed (see official catalog course descriptions). General Education track. Semester Min totals verified: 16/15/16/16/15/15/16/14. The QuEST track is not included: its S5/S6 official Total row cannot be reconciled with the plan cells.
